title: Yellowed Smoky Syrian Turkey Neck Kebabs
description: Charred and juicy, these kebabs are a nostalgic Syrian dish featuring smoked turkey neck, served in an agave leaf vessel. The katsuramuki-cut turkey neck is marinated in a blend of spices and yogurt.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Add the smoked turkey neck to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the turkey neck from the marinade and thread onto skewers.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, or until charred and cooked through.
Wrap each kebab in an agave leaf and serve immediately.
Serve with additional lemon wedges and yogurt sauce, if desired.
Discard the agave leaves before eating, as they are not edible.
